Subject: Vendor onboarding checklist + PO timing

Hi Ben —

We're ready to move Redwood onto GlacierPay's vendor roster. Legal/procurement asked me to collect the following artifacts so we can spin up the PO:

- Executed DPA (signed or DocuSign link)
- Link to latest SOC 2 report + date range of coverage
- Full subprocessor inventory (names + locations) — we have a brief EU-data handling checkbox we need to confirm
- W-9 or vendor tax form (if US) and remittance details for invoicing
- Any carrier or insurance certificate you maintain (COI) if available

Can you confirm we can get the DPA + SOC2 link and subprocessor CSV by EOD Tuesday? Also include any notes on billing address and if you accept ACH vs. wire.

Attaching our internal purchase request form (GlacierPay_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf) with the fields our procurement team will fill once they have your artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing this quickly so we can issue PO GLC-45231.

— Maya

Maya — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim (legal ops) and Evelyn (finance) to assemble the pack.

Quick notes and plan:
- I attached Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (standard Redwood mutual DPA). We can send for DocuSign if you prefer executed copy only.
- SOC 2: we host the report via a secure link; I'll pass a short pointer to the most recent Type II (coverage 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28). See SOC2_report_link.txt attached (link + summary).
- Subprocessors: we'll export the inventory as a CSV and flag any subprocessors processing EU personal data.
- Tax/invoice: Redwood accepts ACH and wire. Finance prefers ACH for US customers; remittance address is on our invoice template. Evelyn, can you confirm the payment remittance block and whether we need a W-9 on file?

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Kim to review DPA and prepare DocuSign link; Evelyn to confirm invoice remittance text.
- Tomorrow EOD: deliver SOC2 link + subprocessors CSV + signed DPA link.

If procurement at GlacierPay needs a signed copy first, we can escalate the DocuSign to immediate.

Ben

Thanks Ben — that timeline works. A few clarifications from procurement:

1) We need the DOCUSIGN executed DPA prior to routing the PO for signature. Can you send the DocuSign link or executed PDF?
2) For the SOC2 link, procurement will accept an access-controlled URL plus the auditor name and report date range (you referenced that — please include auditor).
3) Subprocessors: attach as CSV; we will run the list for cross-check against our restricted vendor list. Please indicate which subprocessors (if any) process EU data.
4) Billing: please add "GlacierPay, Inc." as the billing contact name and include our vendor code (GP-45231) on invoices. We prefer ACH; will provide banking details after PO issuance.

I have attached a preliminary PO skeleton (GP_PO_45231.pdf) for reference. Once we receive the signed DPA and supporting artifacts we'll issue a PO and send the final vendor portal invite.

Thanks,
Maya

Attachment: GP_PO_45231.pdf (pdf, 44KB)

Hi Maya — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick status and the rollup pack attached.

Delivered in this message:
- Executed DPA (DocuSign completed) — see DocuSign URL above and attached signed copy Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf.
- SOC 2: hosted report link + auditor: BlackPeak Auditing LLP; coverage 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28. See SOC2_report_link.txt for access instructions.
- Subprocessor inventory: subprocessors_inventory_v2026-11.csv (includes a column "EU_processing" with Y/N flags). We have flagged two subprocessors that handle EU data and included location and contact.
- W-9: attached on request (W9_Redwood_2026.pdf) — if you prefer a different tax form, let us know.
- Remittance: Redwood prefers ACH; remittance block (for your PO) is: Redwood Inference, Attn: AR, 1200 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103. ACH/routing instructions will be sent to accounting contact after PO is live.

Next steps for GlacierPay:
1) Confirm PO number and billing contact (you mentioned GP-45231).
2) Once PO is issued, please confirm whether invoices should include the vendor portal ID or GP-45231 only.
3) Copy accounting@redwood.com on any remittance/banking details for security.

We're targeting contract start the week after PO issuance. If you need a redline to the DPA we can handle minor edits but would prefer to avoid scope changes that require legal review.

Best —
